mapper.insert: insert into deploy_execution (deploy_id, status, exit_code, retry_count, start_time, end_time, error_message) values (#{deployId}, #{status}, #{exitCode}, #{retryCount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.update:
update deploy_execution
status = #{status}, exit_code = #{exitCode}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, error_message = #{errorMessage},
where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select id, deploy_id, status, exit_code, retry_count, start_time, end_time, error_message, create_time, update_time, deleted from deploy_execution where deleted = 0 and deploy_id = #{deployId} order by id desc limit 1

select id, deploy_id, status, exit_code, retry_count, start_time, end_time, error_message, create_time, update_time, deleted from deploy_execution where deleted = 0 and deploy_id = #{deployId} and status = 'RUNNING' order by id desc limit 1
